Compatibility: Insectoid

Elysian Lep’ix have an affinity for the realms of idyll and divine grace. Their mystical gifts harken to the splendor and providence of an ideal world. Their wings tend toward a butterfly’s wing shapes and patterns, and may develop breath-taking stained glass or metal embossed textures, representing symbolic or even prophetic designs. Despite drawing power from the divine, an elysian lep’ix’s powers and wing patterns don’t necessarily draw from an existing divinity. Rather, a particularly devout or fate-bound lep’ix might, but many elysian lep’ix draw from the broader divine energies of elysium instead. This has led to suppositions that elysian lep’ix are lesser divinities in their own right, such as a lesser deva or angel, or else a descendant of one. Any doctrine on the matter, however, is undercut by the fact that lep’ix biology molds just as well to infernal or celestial magic as much as the divine.

When a lep’ix comes of age and develops their magical connection, not only do their wings adapt to the change, but also their mind. A lep’ix becoming elysian begins to carry themselves with an almost unnatural grace, and their speech patterns alter—their mind finding certain patterns and intonations of words more natural to say than before. Elysian Lep’ix are truly sights to behold, and this often gives others pause who have not seen one before.

To lep’ix cultures, elysian flare is less standout, and the differences between them is notable mostly like personality traits are. Elysian Lep’ix communities are highly social, leaning on each other for the skills they lack, both verbally and physically. Others, however, seek out communities they can stand apart from—an elysian lep’ix is less impressive in a crowd of their own.
